goal: A lean UI/UX ruleset for coding agents: always-loaded floors, design guides read before writing interface code, and a specification for a contrast checker script.
keep: Falsifiable rules, numeric thresholds, and behavioral contracts that hold for any interface.
discard: Prose, history, examples, rationale, and styles tied to one framework.
conflicts: Keep the stricter accessibility or ergonomic bound.

targets.name: INVARIANTS
targets.route: Only the strictest universal floors, such as minimum text size, contrast, and touch target size.
targets.format: Dense bullets, one floor per bullet, no rationale.

targets.name: SCRIPT_CONTRAST
targets.route: Luminance or color-space math that a program can verify.
targets.format: A technical specification: command-line interface, every check with its formula and threshold, and the JSON report schema.

targets.name: TYPOGRAPHY
targets.route: Type scale, spacing, and line-length heuristics needed before writing code.
targets.format: Bulleted imperatives and IF -> THEN decisions, no rationale or examples.

targets.name: INTERACTION_FORMS
targets.route: Behavior of controls, forms, validation, and error messages needed before writing code.
targets.format: Bulleted imperatives and IF -> THEN decisions, no rationale or examples.
